name: ConfirmPopover
description: Asks "are you sure?" next to the control that triggered it: a non-modal alertdialog anchored to the trigger with a question, an optional consequence and Cancel / confirm buttons.

children.description: The control that opens the confirmation, usually a Button. It keeps its own label and styling.

title.description: The question, for example "Clear the answers in this section?". Names the dialog. With choices, it asks which one, for example "What do you want to clear?".

description.description: What happens if the person confirms; describes the dialog.

confirmLabel.description: Label of the confirming button; repeat the action, for example "Clear answers". Not used with choices, where each choice has its own.

choices.description: Several actions to pick from first; picking one asks "are you sure?" with that choice's question and labels.

tone.description: "error" for actions that remove or destroy something.

onConfirm.description: Called when the person confirms, with the picked choice's id when there are choices; the popover then closes.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the popover opens or closes, whichever way.

side.description: Preferred side of the trigger; flips when out of room.

className.description: Extra class on the popover surface.
